name: lekh-keyboard
description: Lekh Keyboard companion, daemon, and native input method source for local-first Nepali typing.
author: Lekh

scripts.v1:check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:v1 && npm run build && npm run check:ipc-schema && npm run check:experimental-passive-commit
scripts.v1:package:macos: LEKH_PACKAGE_NEURAL_MODEL=0 LEKH_EXPERIMENTAL_NEURAL_TYPING=0 npm run package:macos:imk:dev && LEKH_PACKAGE_NEURAL_MODEL=0 LEKH_EXPERIMENTAL_NEURAL_TYPING=0 npm run package:macos:imk:test-installer
scripts.test:v1: vitest run src native/daemon/src native/shared native/windows-tsf/skeleton/windowsTsfSource.test.ts --exclude src/engine/keyboard/passiveCommit.test.ts --pool=forks --maxWorkers=2
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:engine-no-dom
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:companion && npm run build && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:native-imk-privacy-security && npm run check:product-truth && npm run check:offline && npm run check:bundle-budget && npm run check:runtime-data && npm run check:user-data && npm run check:ipc-schema && npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:composition-work-bound && npm run check:behavior-contract && npm run check:native-host-risk-matrix && npm run check:human-authority && npm run check:installer-flow && npm run check:third-party-notices && npm run corpus:keyboard:package-check && npm run audit:traditional-layout && npm run check:benchmark-disjointness && npm run benchmark:typing-session && npm run benchmark:dictionary && npm run benchmark:memory && npm run benchmark:romanized:smoke && npm run benchmark:proofread && npm run benchmark:competitor && npm run bench:perf:smoke && npm run verify:engine && npm run scorecard:engine
scripts.verify:full: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:native-imk-privacy-security && npm run check:product-truth && npm run check:offline && npm run check:bundle-budget && npm run check:runtime-data && npm run check:user-data && npm run check:ipc-schema && npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:composition-work-bound && npm run check:behavior-contract && npm run check:native-host-risk-matrix && npm run check:human-authority && npm run check:installer-flow && npm run check:third-party-notices && npm run audit:traditional-layout && npm run check:benchmark-disjointness && npm run benchmark && npm run benchmark:mixed-span-mutations && npm run benchmark:typing-session && npm run benchmark:dictionary && npm run benchmark:memory && npm run bench:perf:full && npm run benchmark:proofread && npm run benchmark:competitor && npm run verify:engine:full && npm run scorecard:engine
scripts.verify:engine: npm run check:engine-local && npm run check:engine-no-dom && npm run benchmark:protected && npm run benchmark:romanized:self:smoke
scripts.verify:engine:full: npm run check:engine-local && npm run check:engine-no-dom && npm run benchmark:protected && npm run alias:romanized && npm run check:alias-collisions && npm run benchmark:romanized:self
scripts.build:companion: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:companion-ui && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:daemon: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && npm run typecheck && npm run test:native-scaffold && node scripts/bundle-daemon.mjs
scripts.package:windows: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && npm run check:windows-installer-contract && node scripts/package-windows-companion.mjs --signed
scripts.package:windows:unsigned: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && npm run check:windows-installer-contract && node scripts/package-windows-companion.mjs --unsigned
scripts.package:macos:imk:dev: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/package-macos-imk-dev.mjs
scripts.package:macos:imk:test-installer: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/package-macos-imk-test-installer.mjs
scripts.package:macos:appcast: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/package-macos-appcast.mjs
scripts.package:macos:release-manifest: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/sign-release-directory-manifest.mjs
scripts.neural:student:setup: python3.11 -m venv .tmp/coreml-student-venv && .tmp/coreml-student-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && .tmp/coreml-student-venv/bin/python -m pip install coremltools==8.3.0 numpy==2.2.6
scripts.neural:open-vocab:setup: python3.11 -m venv .tmp/neural-seq2seq-venv && .tmp/neural-seq2seq-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && .tmp/neural-seq2seq-venv/bin/python -m pip install torch==2.3.1 numpy==1.26.4 coremltools==8.3.0
scripts.check:neural-phase3-6: npm run neural:phase3:distillation && npm run neural:phase4:training-contract && npm run neural:phase5:evaluate && npm run neural:phase5:benchmark && npm run neural:phase6:native-integration
scripts.check:neural-phase3-9: npm run check:neural-phase3-6 && npm run neural:phase7:review-intake && npm run neural:phase8:training-run && npm run neural:phase9:promotion
scripts.check:neural-phase3-9:production: node scripts/check-neural-distillation-plan.mjs --production && node scripts/check-neural-training-contract.mjs --production && node scripts/evaluate-neural-open-vocab-model.mjs --production --predictions data/generated/neural-open-vocab-model/lekh-open-vocab-seq2seq-v1/gold-predictions.jsonl && node scripts/benchmark-neural-coreml-device.mjs --production --measurements data/generated/neural-open-vocab-model/lekh-open-vocab-seq2seq-v1/coreml-packaged-app-measurements.json && node scripts/check-neural-native-integration.mjs --production && node scripts/check-neural-review-intake.mjs --production && node scripts/prepare-neural-training-run.mjs --production && node scripts/check-neural-production-promotion.mjs --production
scripts.check:neural-phase0-10: npm run check:neural-contract && npm run check:neural-gold && npm run check:neural-open-vocab-data && npm run check:neural-phase3-9 && node scripts/check-neural-model-selection.mjs && node scripts/check-neural-transliteration-readiness.mjs && npm run neural:phase10:sota
scripts.check:neural-phase0-10:production: npm run check:neural-gold:production; gold=$?; npm run check:neural-open-vocab-data:production; data=$?; node scripts/check-neural-distillation-plan.mjs --production; distill=$?; node scripts/check-neural-training-contract.mjs --production; train_contract=$?; node scripts/evaluate-neural-open-vocab-model.mjs --production --predictions data/generated/neural-open-vocab-model/lekh-open-vocab-seq2seq-v1/gold-predictions.jsonl; eval=$?; node scripts/benchmark-neural-coreml-device.mjs --production --measurements data/generated/neural-open-vocab-model/lekh-open-vocab-seq2seq-v1/coreml-packaged-app-measurements.json; bench=$?; node scripts/check-neural-native-integration.mjs --production; native=$?; node scripts/check-neural-review-intake.mjs --production; review=$?; node scripts/prepare-neural-training-run.mjs --production; training=$?; node scripts/check-neural-model-selection.mjs --production; selection=$?; node scripts/check-neural-transliteration-readiness.mjs --production; readiness=$?; node scripts/check-neural-production-promotion.mjs --production; promotion=$?; node scripts/check-neural-sota-worldclass.mjs --production; sota=$?; if [ $gold -ne 0 ] || [ $data -ne 0 ] || [ $distill -ne 0 ] || [ $train_contract -ne 0 ] || [ $eval -ne 0 ] || [ $bench -ne 0 ] || [ $native -ne 0 ] || [ $review -ne 0 ] || [ $training -ne 0 ] || [ $selection -ne 0 ] || [ $readiness -ne 0 ] || [ $promotion -ne 0 ] || [ $sota -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
scripts.check:level5-forensic: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && node scripts/check-level5-forensic-compliance.mjs && npm run check:level5-proof-matrix
scripts.check:level5-forensic:production: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit; passive=$?; npm run check:macos-update-security:production; update=$?; node scripts/check-level5-forensic-compliance.mjs --production; compliance=$?; npm run check:level5-proof-matrix:production; matrix=$?; if [ $passive -ne 0 ] || [ $update -ne 0 ] || [ $compliance -ne 0 ] || [ $matrix -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
scripts.package:macos: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/package-native-macos-companion.mjs --signed
scripts.package:macos:unsigned: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/package-native-macos-companion.mjs
scripts.package:macos:electron:unsigned: npm run check:experimental-passive-commit && npm run check:ipc-schema && node scripts/package-macos-companion.mjs --unsigned
scripts.corpus:keyboard:pipeline: npm run corpus:keyboard && npm run corpus:keyboard:curate && npm run corpus:keyboard:train && npm run corpus:keyboard:validate
scripts.benchmark: npm run benchmark:fixtures && LEKH_BENCHMARK_CLI=1 vite-node scripts/benchmark-summary.ts && npm run benchmark:typing-session
